mechanism: Merc actors get no point lights: each draw converts one light-group (3 directional lights dir0-2 plus ambient) to vu-lights (goal_src/jak1/engine/draw/drawable.gc:500-548, goal_src/jak1/engine/gfx/foreground/bones.gc:222). The group is picked by the actor's draw-control light-index from its level's mood-context light-group[0..7] (drawable.gc:505-510); 255 falls back to the player's group. Group 0 is the sun/moon kit that update-mood-palette/-quick write every frame from the level's mood-lights-table hour snapshots (goal_src/jak1/engine/gfx/mood/mood.gc:146-204, 259-287), plus dir2 effects (lightning mood.gc:474, lava mood.gc:587-592). Groups 1-7 are static per-level light kits (goal_src/jak1/engine/gfx/mood/mood-tables.gc:13-205) refreshed in update-mood-<level>. Positional lighting is faked: update-mood-<level> measures target/camera distance to hard-coded points and either blends the player into a kit (set-target-light-index + target-interp, lerped at goal_src/jak1/engine/gfx/mood/time-of-day.gc:403-437) or rewrites a direction/level/colour (village2 kit 6, jungleb, village3, ogre, finalboss, citadel, darkcave crystals).
light_index: 'light-index' is an entity lump read at goal_src/jak1/engine/common-obs/process-drawable.gc:373 into draw-control light-index (goal_src/jak1/engine/data/art-h.gc:236). NPC init methods also set it in code. It selects which of the level's 8 light-groups lights that actor: 0 = sun kit (default, lump absent), 1-7 = level light kits (indoor or under-glow), 255 = use the player's current light group (drawable.gc:508). Lump users: village1 crate-3147=6, crate-3145=7, warp-gate-switch-3/evilplant-2=1; village2 ceilingflag x4=5, warp-gate-switch-7/villageb-water=1, sunken-elevator=255; jungleb plats/eggtop/darkvines=1-2, ecovents/iris doors/plant-boss=2-3; rolling pushers=1/4, gorge=3; sunken exit-chamber=255; village3 cavegem-1=1. No crate or ecovent outside jungleb/village1 carries it.

conventions.units: pos in metres (game units/4096); a null y means the check uses the target/camera y (horizontal distance only)
conventions.dir: points from the lit surface toward the light (shadow = -dir, mood-tables.gc:207-218); (0,-1,0) = light from below
conventions.colour: raw light-group colour multiplier (can exceed 1; vu-lights scale by levels.x), not clamped
conventions.kind: directional | positional (has a world position) | region-kit (position+radius that switches the player to a directional kit) | none
conventions.affects: merc = actor light-group; palette = tfrag/tie time-of-day palette weights only; both
conventions.gating: all effect code is also gated by *time-of-day-effects* unless noted; no vanilla ambient uses the 'dark' type (ambient.gc:500) and none carries light data
